Vehicles & Highway Tolls
  • 2× Station Wagons (Combi / Touring): Pick up & return at Munich Airport Car Rental Center (MAC, Level 03) via Sixt, Europcar, or Avis (VW Passat Variant / Skoda Octavia Combi / BMW 3 Touring).
  • German Highways: 100% toll-free.

Booked Accommodations (All 3 Bases Confirmed)

Grainau • Lake Eibsee & Zugspitze
Base 1 • Nights 1–4 (Aug 17–21) ✓ Booked • 9.8/10

Das Sonneneck Appartements

Waxensteinstraße 23, 82491 Grainau
  • Setup: Renovated alpine apartments, mountain-view balconies, full kitchens w/ dishwasher, minimarket/bar, free private parking for both cars (+ EV charger).
  • Zugspitze Proximity: Only 6 mins (4.5 km) to Zugspitze Cable Car & Lake Eibsee (includes GrainauCard for free Eibsee-Bus).
  • Highway Advantage: Right by B23 — saves 15m each way to Imst/Area 47 & bypasses Garmisch town traffic via Kramer tunnel.
  • Walkable Dinners (1–4m walk): Spatzenhäus'l (#21), Lokal zur Molle (#46), Il Giardino (#1), Da Franco, Zum Dorfbrunnen.
Booking.com Google Maps
Fügen • Zillertal & Lake Achensee
Base 2 • Nights 5–7 (Aug 21–24) ✓ Booked • 9.3/10

Chalets Almdorf Zillertal, Fügen

Hauptstraße 25, 6263 Fügen, Austria
  • Setup: 120 m² detached timber chalet with 5 bedrooms (3× double, 1× triple, 1× single = 7 beds; full privacy for 16G) & 4 bathrooms, full kitchen, infrared cabin + sauna, free parking.
  • Check-In & Deposit: Check-in 15:00–18:00, check-out by 10:00. Bring EUR 250 cash deposit (refunded via bank transfer in 14d); confirm linen/towels with Belvilla.
  • Walkable Dinners: Gasthof Edhof (2m walk), Pizzeria Il Pittore (7m walk), KOSIS Fun Food Bar (10m walk), Pizzeria Villaggio (12m walk / 2m drive).
  • Quick Drives: 3m drive (1.5–1.7 km) to Spieljochbahn & Erlebnistherme; 4m to A12 motorway.
Booking.com Google Maps
Erding • Therme Lagoon & Waterslides
Base 3 • Nights 8–9 (Aug 24–26) ✓ Booked • 8.9 Loc

Victory Gästehaus Therme Erding

Thermenallee 1 / Austraße 44, 85435 Erding
  • Setup: Modern Family Studios & Apartments with kitchenettes, balconies, free on-site parking lot & garage (+ EV charging), and access to Hotel Victory restaurants across the street.
  • Check-In & Check-Out: Check-in from 15:00, check-out until 11:00 (leave both cars parked free at the guest house on Day 10 while at the Therme!).
  • 1–2m Walk (100m): Directly across Thermenallee from Therme Erding & Galaxy Water Slide World.
  • Munich & Airport Access: 10m walk (800m) to Altenerding S-Bahn (S2) for Marienplatz; 16m drive (15.5 km) to MUC Airport.

10-Day Itinerary, Multi-Stop Google Maps Routes & Weather Backups

Day 1 • Tue, Aug 17 1h 52m total drive (132 km) • Base 1: Grainau

Munich North Action (Olympic Roof Zip Line, BMW Welt & Bikes) → Das Sonneneck Grainau

Day 1 Driving Route Plan B Route
Olympiapark Munich • Stadium Tent Roof & BMW Welt
  • 10:10 • MUC Airport
    Land on LH683 at Munich Airport (MUC) and pick up 2× Station Wagons at Car Rental Center (MAC, Level 03).
    Drive 1 (30m | 32 km): MUC → A92 West → A9 South (Exit 73) → Olympiapark (Spiridon-Louis-Ring 21).
  • 11:30 • Olympiapark
    Olympic Stadium Tent Roof Climb & Flying Fox Zip Line: Harness walk across the stadium roof + 200m Flying Fox zip line over the arena (book 12:00 slot online). Walk 5m across the footbridge to BMW Welt (free entry — supercars & motorcycles).
  • 14:30 • English Garden
    Drive 2 (12m | 5 km): Petuelring → Isarring → English Garden.
    Lunch: Seehaus Beer Garden (lakeside Bavarian), L'Osteria Schwabing (45cm pizzas), or JaVi Schwabing (sushi & bowls).
    Rent bikes for a 1.5h loop through the English Garden and watch river surfers at Eisbachwelle.
  • 18:30 • Grainau Base 1
    Drive 3 to Das Sonneneck (1h 10m | 95 km): A95 South → B2 South → B23 West (Kramer tunnel bypass around Garmisch) → Das Sonneneck Appartements (Waxensteinstraße 23).
    Walkable Dinner (1–3m walk): Pizzeria Il Giardino (#1), Pizzeria Da Franco, or Spatzenhäus'l (#21) — or drive 10m to Garmisch for May Măn (sushi & Thai).
All Day 1 Locations: MUC Car Rental Olympiapark Roof Climb BMW Welt Seehaus / English Garden Eisbachwelle Surfers Das Sonneneck Grainau
Bad-Weather Plan B (Rain/Storm): BMW Welt & BMW Museum are 100% indoors; replace the outdoor Roof Climb & bikes with Allianz Arena Indoor Stadium & FC Bayern Museum or Jochen Schweizer Arena (Taufkirchen, 20m south — Indoor Skydiving wind tunnel & Citywave indoor surfing).
Day 2 • Wed, Aug 18 12m total drive (9 km) • Right in Grainau

Zugspitze Summit (2,962m Glacier) & Lake Eibsee Boating / E-MTB

Day 2 Driving Route Plan B Route
Zugspitze Summit (2,962m) & Turquoise Lake Eibsee
  • 08:30 • 6m Drive
    Drive from Das Sonneneck (6m | 4.5 km): Turn right on Waxensteinstraße → Eibseestraße straight up to Parkplatz Eibsee (Am Eibsee 6) — or ride the free Eibsee-Bus with your GrainauCard.
  • 09:00 • Zugspitze
    Zugspitze Cable Car & Glacier (2,962m): Ascend to Germany's highest peak, cross the German-Austrian border ridge, ride Gletscherbahn to the glacier for free summer snow tubing, and descend via Cogwheel Train (Adults EUR 70.50, Teens EUR 31).
  • 13:00 • Lake Eibsee
    Lunch: Eibsee Pavillon (lakeside terrace pizza & Bavarian food).
    14:15 – Lake Eibsee Boats & E-MTB Trail: Rent pedal boats with slides, rowboats, or SUPs (EUR 14–21/hr) + swim in turquoise water, then rent E-MTBs for a 1.5h trail ride around Eibsee & Badersee.
  • 19:30 • Dinner
    Dinner: Asakusa Sushi (Garmisch, 10m drive — sharing sushi boat & bento boxes) or walk 4m from Das Sonneneck to Gasthaus Zum Dorfbrunnen (Grainau).
All Day 2 Locations: Zugspitze Cable Car Eibsee Pavillon & Boats Eibsee Bikegarage Badersee Asakusa Sushi
Bad-Weather Plan B (Rain/Clouds): First swap with Day 3 or Day 4 (check the Zugspitze live webcam — often 2,962m sits in sunshine above valley clouds). If stormy all day: DAV Boulderhalle Garmisch (12m drive) or Ehrwald Indoor Climbing Hall (15m drive) + Zugspitzbad Grainau (4m walk from Das Sonneneck).
Day 3 • Thu, Aug 19 32m total drive (22 km) • Garmisch-Partenkirchen

Partnachklamm Gorge Hike, Ski Jump Zip Line & Kletterwald High Ropes

Day 3 Driving Route
Partnachklamm Gorge Waterfalls & Garmisch Sommerrodelbahn
  • 09:00 • Partnachklamm
    Drive 1 from Das Sonneneck (14m | 9.5 km): Waxensteinstraße → B23 East to Parkplatz Skistadion.
    Partnachklamm Gorge Hike: Hike through carved rock tunnels & roaring waterfalls up to Kaiserschmarrn-Alm (~2.5h round-trip) for Schnitzel & caramelized skillet Kaiserschmarrn.
  • 13:00 • Zip & Ropes
    Olympic Ski Jump Flying Fox & Kletterwald Garmisch: Ride the Flying Fox zip line beside the Olympic Ski Jump, then drive 6m (3.5 km) to Wankbahnstraße 2 for 13 treetop courses up to 17m high (EUR 34 combo ticket).
  • 19:30 • Dinner
    Dinner (Garmisch, 12m back to Das Sonneneck via Kramer tunnel): L'Osteria Garmisch, Thai Street Food (Pad Thai & curries), or Zum Wildschütz.
All Day 3 Locations: Olympia-Skistadion Partnachklamm Gorge Kaiserschmarrn-Alm Kletterwald Ropes L'Osteria Garmisch
Bad-Weather Plan B (Rain/Storm): Partnachklamm Gorge is spectacular in rain (rock tunnels & thundering waterfalls — wear rain jackets) and Kletterwald operates in light rain under forest canopy. If thunderstorms close the ropes course, switch afternoon to DAV Boulderhalle Garmisch or Zugspitzbad Grainau (4m walk from Das Sonneneck).
Day 4 • Fri, Aug 20 2h 05m total drive (146 km) • 15m faster each way from Grainau

Imst 3.5 km Alpine Coaster, Area 47 Water Action Park & Highline179 Bridge

Day 4 Driving Route Plan B Route
Imst 3.5 km Alpine Coaster & Area 47 Water Park
  • 09:30 • Imst Coaster
    Drive 1 from Das Sonneneck (45m | 55 km): B23 West → B187 (Ehrwald) → B179 Fernpass to Imst Alpine Coaster (Hoch-Imst 19). Ride the world's longest alpine coaster (3.5 km, 500m vertical drop). Activate your Austrian 10-Day Vignette before entering A12.
  • 12:00 • Area 47
    Drive 2 (15m | 16 km): A12 East (Exit 123 Ötztal) → Area 47 Water Area (Ötztaler Achstraße 1).
    Lunch: Lakeside Restaurant inside Area 47.
    13:00–17:00 – Water Action Park (EUR 46 incl. wetsuit): Water catapult (cannonball), blobbing, 5 extreme speed slides, slip-and-slide surf ramp, wakeboarding & cliff-diving towers.
  • 17:40 • Highline179
    Drive 3 back to Das Sonneneck (1h 05m total | 75 km): Stop on B179 North (38m) at Highline179 Suspension Bridge (Reutte — 406m span, 114m high), then 28m back to Das Sonneneck.
    19:30 – Dinner: Walk 1m to Spatzenhäus'l / Lokal zur Molle, or drive 10m to Garmisch for Gasthof Fraundorfer or Thang Long (Vietnamese phở & wok).
All Day 4 Locations: Imst 3.5km Coaster Area 47 Water Park Highline179 Bridge Spatzenhäus'l Grainau
Bad-Weather Plan B (Rain/Storm): Area 47 Water Area & Whitewater Rafting run in rain (wetsuits included!). If thunderstorms close outdoor slides & Imst Coaster, do Area 47's indoor bouldering cave + Aqua Dome Längenfeld (20m south) OR drive 45m to Innsbruck for B1 Indoor Go-Karting & Laser Tag + FLIP LAB Trampoline Park.
Day 5 • Sat, Aug 21 1h 34m total drive (97.5 km) • Move to Base 2: Fügen

Check Out of Das Sonneneck → Lake Achensee (AirRofan & Boat) → Chalets Almdorf Zillertal

Day 5 Driving Route Plan B Route
Lake Achensee Fjord & Rofan Cable Car (AirRofan)
  • 09:00 • Scenic Drive
    Drive 1 from Das Sonneneck (1h 20m | 84 km): B23 East → B2 (Mittenwald / Wallgau) → B307 across the Sylvensteinsee Bridge → B181 (Achenpass) to Rofanseilbahn Maurach (Achenseestraße 10).
  • 10:30 • AirRofan
    Rofan Cable Car & AirRofan Skyglider: Ascend to 1,840m and fly the 80 km/h eagle zip line from Gschöllkopf (2,040m) (EUR 18 adults / EUR 12.50 youth).
  • 13:00 • Achensee
    Lunch (Maurach / Pertisau): Arthur's Pizzeria Venezia, Gasthof Kirchenwirt, or SeeSushi Pertisau.
    14:30 – Lake Achensee Electric Boat & Swim: Rent a self-drive electric motorboat (fits 6, no license needed) + swim at Atoll Achensee / Buchau Beach.
  • 17:15 • Fügen Base 2
    Drive 2 to Chalets Almdorf Zillertal (14m | 13.5 km): B181 South → B169 South → Exit Fügen-Nord → Chalets Almdorf Zillertal (Hauptstraße 25, Fügen) (check-in by 18:00; have EUR 250 cash deposit ready).
    Walkable Dinner: Walk 2m to Gasthof Edhof, walk 7m to Pizzeria Il Pittore, walk 12m (or drive 2m) to Pizzeria Villaggio, or drive 3m to Asia Cooking (Schlitters).
All Day 5 Locations: Sylvensteinsee Rofanseilbahn & AirRofan Atoll Achensee & Boats Chalets Almdorf Fügen Pizzeria Il Pittore
Bad-Weather Plan B (Rain/Storm): Stop right on route at Schwaz Silver Mine (Silberbergwerk Schwaz) (14m from chalet — 100% underground mine train 800m inside the mountain) + Swarovski Kristallwelten (Wattens, 22m — 18 underground crystal chambers & 4-story indoor play/climbing tower) or Atoll Achensee (indoor pool & bouldering).
Day 6 • Sun, Aug 22 6–30m total drive (3–33 km) • From Chalets Almdorf Fügen

Spieljoch 5.5 km Mountain Carts, Wolfsklamm Gorge / Ziller Bikes & Erlebnistherme

Day 6 Driving Route Plan B Route
Zillertal Alps • Spieljoch Mountain Carts & River Rafting
  • 09:30 • Spieljoch
    Spieljochbahn & 5.5 km Mountain Carts: Drive 3m (1.7 km) (or walk 18m) from Hauptstraße 25 to Spieljochbahn (Spieljochweg 2). Ride the gondola to 1,860m and race 3-wheeled Mountain Carts down the 5.5 km track.
    12:30 – Lunch: Mountain Loft (summit wood-fired pizza) or Pizzeria Il Pittore (7m walk from chalet).
  • 14:00 • Gorge / Bike
    Afternoon Choice from Chalets Almdorf:
    • Option A (Hike — 15m drive | 15 km): Hike Wolfsklamm Gorge (Stans) (354 steps & wooden bridges over emerald waterfalls).
    • Option B (Bikes — 2m ride | 600m): Ride 600m east from the chalet onto the flat Zillertal River Bike Trail (Zillertalradweg).
  • 16:30 • Thermal Slides
    Erlebnistherme Zillertal (Badweg 1) (3m drive | 1.5 km or 15m walk): 2 timed high-speed tube/raft slides (133m & 134m), wave pool & outdoor brine pool — plus your chalet's own infrared cabin & sauna!
    19:30 – Dinner: Walk 2m to Gasthof Edhof (steaks & schnitzel), walk 10m to KOSIS Fun Food Bar, or drive 14m to Mimi Restaurant (Schwaz — sushi & Thai).
All Day 6 Locations: Spieljochbahn & Carts Wolfsklamm Gorge Erlebnistherme Zillertal Gasthof Edhof (2m walk)
Bad-Weather Plan B (Rain/Storm): Erlebnistherme Zillertal is 100% indoors. Replace outdoor carts/gorge with KABOOOM / KRAFTreich Kaltenbach (8m drive south — indoor climbing/bouldering, AirTrack trampoline, bowling & skate bowl) + Visorium Mayrhofen (22m drive — indoor Alpine Escape Rooms & adventure golf).
Day 7 • Mon, Aug 23 1h 38m total drive (98 km) • Deep Zillertal Valley

Arena Coaster, Zillertal Whitewater Rafting & Hintertux Ice Palace / Krimml Falls

Route A: Glacier Cave Route B: Krimml Falls
Krimml Waterfalls (380m) & Hintertux Glacier Ice Palace
  • 09:30 • Zell am Ziller
    Drive 1 from Chalets Almdorf (15m | 15.5 km): Hauptstraße 25 → B169 South to Arena Coaster (Rohr 23, Zell am Ziller) (1,450m coaster with 360° loops).
    Join a 2.5h Zillertal Whitewater Rafting trip on the Ziller River (teen-friendly Class II–III rapids).
  • 13:00 • Lunch
    Lunch: Pizzeria Ristorante Quattro (Kaltenbach) or Gasthof Bräu (Zell am Ziller).
  • 14:30 • Glacier / Falls
    Afternoon Choice & Return to Chalets Almdorf:
    • Option A (Glacier Cave — 35m | 34 km from Zell): Ascend Hintertux Glacier (3,250m) to tour Nature's Ice Palace (Natur Eis Palast) — boat/kayak on an underground glacier lake 30m inside the ice (48m | 49 km drive back to Fügen).
    • Option B (Waterfalls — 42m | 38 km from Zell): Hike Krimml Waterfalls (380m) + rent pedal boats at Durlassboden Alpine Reservoir (55m | 53 km drive back to Fügen).
  • 19:30 • Dinner
    Dinner: Mr. Lei (Mayrhofen — top Zillertal sushi & Asian, right on the drive back from Hintertux) or walk 10m from your chalet to KOSIS Fun Food Bar (Fügen).
All Day 7 Locations: Arena Coaster Hintertux Glacier & Ice Palace Krimml Waterfalls Mr. Lei Mayrhofen
Bad-Weather Plan B (Rain/Storm): Nearly 100% rain-proof as planned! Whitewater Rafting runs in rain (you're in wetsuits), the Arena Coaster mounts transparent plexiglass rain canopies over every sled when it rains, and Nature's Ice Palace is completely underground inside the glacier (0°C and dry).
Day 8 • Tue, Aug 24 3h 25m total drive (315 km) • Move to Base 3: Therme Erding

Check Out of Chalets Almdorf → Salzburg, Hallein Salt Mine & Golling Falls → Victory Gästehaus Erding

Day 8 Driving Route Plan B Route
Salzburg Old Town, Hohensalzburg Fortress & Hallein Salt Mine
  • 08:45 • To Salzburg
    Check out of Chalets Almdorf Zillertal before 10:00.
    Drive 1 (1h 25m | 132 km): Hauptstraße 25 → B169 North (4m to motorway) → A12 / A93 / A8 East → Mönchsberg Underground Garage (Hildmannplatz 1).
  • 10:30 • Salzburg
    Hohensalzburg Fortress & Old Town: Ride FestungsBahn Funicular to the fortress, then stroll Getreidegasse & Residenzplatz.
    12:30 – Lunch: Bärenwirt (famous Wiener Schnitzel), L'Osteria Salzburg, or Mister Le (right at garage exit — Pad Thai & curries).
  • 14:30 • Salt Mine
    Drive 2 (20m | 18 km): A10 South (Exit 16 Hallein) → Salzwelten Salzburg (Hallein Salt Mine). Ride the mining train inside the mountain, race down 2 wooden miner slides, and cross the underground salt lake by raft (book 14:30 slot; Keltenblitz 2.2 km toboggan is right outside).
  • 16:15 • Falls & Erding
    Stop 15m south at Golling Waterfall (Wasserfallstraße 23) (40m forest walk to a roaring 75m waterfall).
    Drive 3 to Victory Gästehaus Therme Erding (1h 40m | 165 km): A10 North → A8 West → B15 North → B388 → Victory Gästehaus Therme Erding (Thermenallee 1).
    19:00 – Dinner: Walk 1m (100m) to Hafenrestaurant (Hotel Victory), or drive 5m to Huong Viet (sushi & Vietnamese) or Gasthof Erdinger Weißbräu.
All Day 8 Locations: Mönchsberg Garage Hohensalzburg Fortress Hallein Salt Mine Golling Waterfall Victory Gästehaus Erding
Bad-Weather Plan B (Rain/Storm): Hallein Salt Mine is 100% underground and Hohensalzburg Fortress is mostly indoors. If pouring rain in Salzburg, replace outdoor stroll & Golling Waterfall with Red Bull Hangar-7 (free indoor glass dome with F1 cars & stunt planes) or Haus der Natur Science Museum.
Day 9 • Wed, Aug 25 S-Bahn S2 (45m) or Car (25–38m) • From Victory Gästehaus Erding

Munich City Sights (Marienplatz / Allianz Arena) & Teen Shopping Mile

Day 9 Driving Route S-Bahn S2 Route
Munich Marienplatz, Neues Rathaus & Pedestrian Shopping Mile
  • 09:30 • To Munich
    From Victory Gästehaus into Munich:
    • By Car (25m | 29 km to Allianz Arena; 38m | 36 km to center): Drive to Allianz Arena, then park at Fröttmaning P+R (U6 16m to Marienplatz) or downtown at Contipark Oberpollinger (Maxburgstraße 7).
    • By Train (zero parking hassle): Walk 10m (800m) (or drive 2m to free P+R) to Altenerding S-Bahn (S2) → 45m direct to Marienplatz.
  • 10:15 • Sights & Lunch
    Morning Sights: Marienplatz & Neues Rathaus Tower (85m elevator deck), climb St. Peter's Tower (Alter Peter), and stroll Viktualienmarkt & Odeonsplatz — OR tour Allianz Arena & FC Bayern Museum.
    13:00 – Lunch: L'Osteria Künstlerhaus, Augustiner Stammhaus, or Kaimug / Secret Vietnam.
  • 14:15 • Shopping Mile
    Teen Shopping (Kaufingerstraße & Neuhauser Straße): Sport Schuster (7-story sports flagship w/ indoor climbing wall), Snipes, Foot Locker, Solebox, Uniqlo, Zara, Bershka, Pull&Bear, Urban Outfitters, Apple Store Rosenstraße, & Oberpollinger.
    19:30 – Dinner (Erding, 4–5m drive from Victory Gästehaus): Pizzeria La Speranza or Asien Perle (BBQ & sushi buffet).
All Day 9 Locations: Altenerding S-Bahn Allianz Arena Marienplatz Sport Schuster Kaufingerstraße Shopping
Bad-Weather Plan B (Rain/Storm): Almost 100% weather-proof! Allianz Arena, Sport Schuster, Oberpollinger, Stachus Passagen, and Fünf Höfe shopping arcades are all indoors. If pouring rain in the morning, replace outdoor squares with Deutsches Museum.
Day 10 • Thu, Aug 26 1m walk to Therme + 16m drive (15.5 km) to MUC Airport

Therme Erding & Galaxy Water Slide World (28 Slides) → Evening Flight Home

Day 10 Airport Route
Therme Erding • 28 Galaxy Waterslides & Thermal Wave Lagoon
  • 10:00–16:00 • Therme
    Check out of Victory Gästehaus Therme Erding by 11:00, load suitcases into your 2 station wagons (leave cars parked free at the guest house), and walk 1–2m (100m) across the street to Therme Erding & Galaxy Water Slide World (Thermenallee 1–5).
    6-Hour Ticket (EUR 49): 28 waterslides (Family, Action, X-Treme incl. Kamikaze freefall, 8-lane mat racer, VR slides, 365m outdoor raft slide) + giant palm-tree wave lagoon & crazy river. Eat lunch inside the lagoon.
  • 16:30 • To MUC Airport
    Drive from Victory Gästehaus to MUC (16m | 15.5 km): St2580 North straight to Munich Airport. Refuel at OMV Airport Gas Station (Südallee 1), return cars at MAC (Level 03), and board LH682 at 19:45 (lands TLV 00:35 +1).
All Day 10 Locations: Therme Erding & Galaxy Slides OMV Airport Gas Station MUC Car Rental Return
Bad-Weather Plan B (Rain/Storm): 100% weather-proof — the giant glass domes stay closed in rain/storms, with 20 indoor Galaxy waterslides, the palm-tree wave lagoon, and indoor thermal pools operating in all weather.
